summary_1line: Vishwamitra continues austerities seeking higher sagehood while King Trishanku asks Vasishtha to help him ascend bodily to heaven and is refused.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Trishanku stands humbly before the sage Vasishtha, asking to ascend to heaven in his physical body while the austere hermitage surrounds them.
Vishwamitra performs severe penance in the wilderness as Brahma appears before him with the gods in radiant light.
